preconditions.description: Attacker must hold sufficient tokens in the contract to initiate transfer
Attacker must deploy a malicious contract with receive/fallback function capable of re-entering transfer

exploit_hint: Deploy a malicious contract with a receive/fallback function that calls transfer() again during token receipt. Call transfer() to your malicious contract, and in the receive hook, re-enter the transfer function before balance state is fully updated. This could potentially allow double-spending if the _beforeTokenTransfer hook is overridden in a child contract to make external calls before state updates. Monitor attacker token balance to verify if it increased beyond expected amount after the reentrancy attack.
